entry.title: Protocol 2.0: CodeCrew Moves Out of Your Repository's Root
entry.summary: CodeCrew's first protocol major moves every file it owns under .codecrew/, refuses the old layout outright rather than shipping a compatibility shim, and hands adopters a one-shot migrate verb — here is why it broke, what you run, and what an evening of migrating a ten-repository fleet taught the release that followed.
